summary: Alpha Tau Medical Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing an interim clinical data presentation from its U.S. REGAIN trial of Alpha DaRT for recurrent glioblastoma, disclosed via a May 11, 2026 conference call and webcast. No special-situation corporate event is involved; the filing is a routine foreign private issuer report of clinical updates. No deal terms, shareholder actions, or structural changes are present. The filing is purely informational and not deemed filed for Exchange Act purposes. This is not a special situation.
